term: International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems
definition: The International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems or AAMAS is the leading scientific conference for research in the areas of artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, and multiagent systems.
details: It is annually organized by a non-profit organization called the International Foundation for Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (IFAAMAS).
story: Picture hiring a brilliant new assistant on their first morning — smart, motivated, but with no idea how anything in your office actually works. It plans a little, acts a little, looks at the result, and then decides what to do next. It is the difference between a search engine and a helper who actually finishes the task. The model stops being a one-shot answer machine and becomes a coworker that checks its own work. That loop of reason, act, and observe is International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems.
